task_title: low-intensity/near-zero reference/frequency cutoff/evanescent/backflow에서 NaN·음의 국소 flux·invalid phase를 임의 clipping으로 숨기지 않는다

physics_configuration.table: docs/NUMERICAL_GUARDS.md: every path, its guard, its declared threshold and its test
physics_configuration.injections: zero reference, reference at 5e-3 of the peak, reference against its dominant direction, negative numerator with a declared direction, NaN; synthetic monitor records with a zero reference and a reversed transmission flux; S at 1e-20, a phase step of 3.14 rad between neighbours, two frequencies; a Rayleigh order at grazing cutoff (order 1 at lambda 2 um, period 2 um) and an evanescent order 2; a two-frequency reference weak at one frequency for diffraction and far field; a 12-step modal run whose far plane carries no signal; a zero-intensity allocation plane

thresholds.phase_magnitude_floor: rounding floor of the S dtype times max |S|

reference_method: each injected situation has a known correct outcome (NaN with a named reason, or a ValueError with a named message); the valid entries of the same arrays are compared with the unguarded quotient to show that nothing else changed

observables.name: reason
observables.definition: record.reasons[name][index] or the ValueError message for every injected situation

observables.name: untouched_ratio
observables.definition: the ratio at valid entries equals numerator / |reference| exactly

acceptance_limits.reasons: every injected situation yields the reason listed in docs/NUMERICAL_GUARDS.md for its path; no injected situation yields a finite clipped number or an absolute value
acceptance_limits.no_epsilon: no denominator is offset: a zero reference is refused or flagged, never divided
acceptance_limits.precision: a float32 reference at 1e-8 of its peak is flagged by the rounding floor while a float64 one at 1e-6 with a 1e-9 fraction is not
acceptance_limits.source_of_limits: G6-08 specification; thresholds declared in the fixture above and in docs/NUMERICAL_GUARDS.md before the run

applicable_scope: CPU numpy and torch injections in float32 and float64; a 12-step float32 modal run; the differentiable paths' whole-call refusals
verification_reason: no failures or errors, and no required test skipped or absent

null_reasons.observed_metrics: no observed-metrics file was supplied; the JUnit pass/fail record is the only measurement
